tools.name: find_posters
tools.description: Search GiftsToPrint's personalised newspaper-style posters. Each poster shows real headlines and events from one year, personalised with a name, photo and message, and is delivered as a print-ready digital file (nothing is posted). Birthday posters and wedding-anniversary posters exist per milestone

tools.name: get_poster_form
tools.description: List exactly what to collect from the user for one poster: names, dates, optional message, and the photo, plus the turnaround options and prices. Ask the user for anything you don't already know. Don't invent names or dates. Next step: upload_photo, then create_poster_checkout.

tools.name: get_photo_upload_link
tools.description: Create a private web page where the user can upload the poster photo from their phone or computer. findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "create_poster_checkout" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Validate every detail and create a Shopify checkout for one personalised poster with all the details attached. Returns checkout_url. Nothing is charged: open ch…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_posters, get_poster_form, get_photo_upload_link, create_poster_checkout · Private data: find_posters, get_photo_upload_link, upload_photo, create_poster_checkout · Public sink: get_photo_upload_link, upload_photo.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_posters, get_poster_form, get_photo_upload_link, create_poster_checkout · Private data: find_posters, get_photo_upload_link, upload_photo, create_poster_checkout · Public sink: get_photo_upload_link, upload_photo

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
